questions.question: What is 15% of 200?
questions.explanation: 10% of 200 is 20 and 5% is 10, so 15% is 30.

questions.question: A jacket costs £60. It is reduced by 20%. What is the sale price?
A book costs £40. Its price increases by 25%. What is the new price?
Shauri scores 36 marks out of 40. What percentage did he score?
questions.explanation: 36/40 is the same as 9/10, which is 90%.

questions.question: 20% of a number is 14. What is the number?
questions.explanation: 20% is one fifth. If one fifth is 14, the whole is 14 × 5 = 70.

questions.question: A bicycle originally costs £240. It is reduced by 15%. How much money is taken off the original price?
questions.explanation: 10% of £240 is £24 and 5% is £12. Therefore 15% is £36.

questions.question: A water tank is 75% full. The tank can hold 800 litres altogether. How many litres are needed to fill it completely?
questions.explanation: The tank needs 25% more. One quarter of 800 is 200 litres.

questions.question: A shop has 500 balloons. It sells 30% of them in the morning and then sells another 80 balloons in the afternoon. How many balloons remain?
questions.explanation: 30% of 500 is 150. After the morning 350 remain, and 350 - 80 = 270.
